correctness.rationale: Using Fano incidence u·v≡0 mod2 for nonzero three-bit vectors, each of fourteen Heawood graph vertices has exact distance distribution (1,3,6,4) at lengths (0,1,2,3). Each punctured {1,2} neighborhood is a nine-vertex facet; union of all fourteen facets has 4480 nonempty simplices, f-vector (14,91,364,903,1358,1106,504,126,14). Independently rebuilt greedy free-face/maximal-critical matching gives 2224 matched Hasse pairs and exactly one critical zero-cell, 29 four-cells, two five-cells. Reorienting all 22974 Hasse incidences gives a DAG, and exact signed integer elimination of matched boundaries gives a zero 29×2 critical degree-(5→4) matrix for masks 0x297 and 0x1f80. Since the four-skeleton is 29 S4 and π4→H4 is an isomorphism, the two five-cell attachments are null-homotopic, so the integral wedge is 29 S4∨2 S5. This is a finite exhaustive proof, not a sample or mod-two-only homology inference.

Earlier Heawood Resultary classes on independence, ordinary neighborhood, five-cuts and Čech nerves have different face rules and homology dimensions. The exact 29+2 mixed sphere wedge has not been identified in an earlier covering theorem.
